senses.definition: (general) Very large in size or extent.
examples: Compared to its counterparts from World War II, the Abrams main battle tank is truly massive.

senses.definition: (medicine) Affecting a large portion of the body, or severe.
(physics, of a particle) Having any mass.
examples: Some bosons are massive while others are massless.

subsenses.definition: (mineralogy) Not having an obvious crystalline structure.

senses.definition: (mineralogy) A homogeneous mass of rock, not layered and without an obvious crystal structure.
(MLE, slang) A group of people from a locality, or sharing a collective aim, interest, etc.
